SELECT
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_kod)) AS Code,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_unvan1)) AS Title,
  N'Alıcı / Satıcı' AS Type_,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_vdaire_no)), N''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_tckimlik_no)), N'')) AS TaxNr,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_vdaire_adi)) AS TaxOffice,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_Tel_bolge_kodu + cari_Tel_no1)) AS U_Phone,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_EMail)) AS U_Email,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_adr1_il)) AS Addr_City,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_adr1_ilce)) AS Addr_Town,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(cari_adr1_cadde, N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(cari_adr1_sokak, N''))) AS Addr_Address,
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(cari_hareket_tipi, 0) = 0 THEN N'Evet' ELSE N'Hayır' END AS Active
FROM dbo.CARI_HESAPLAR WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE cari_kod IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(cari_kod)) <> N''
ORDER BY cari_kod
